comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A Memorial Album consisting of seven items which must be created by modifying base items with transmutation alchemy and "Sophia" points. The quest to unlock the appropriate Legacy theme is Legacy TH4. A Fragrance Envied Even by the Home of Aroma -- it will then become selectable under the Book of Wisdom's Legacy theme section.

Using your Book of Wisdom's clock-like discovery section for Legacies, here is which discovery unlocks which recipe (with the location in parentheses):

Top / 12:00 -> Alembic (Northwest Basra)
Unlocks: Fancy Perfume for Sailors

Upper Right / 2:00 -> Scent of a Consort (Yuntaisha West)
Unlocks: Heart

Lower Right / 4:00 -> Queen of Hungary's Water (Frankfurt)
Unlocks: Aroma Pomander

Bottom / 6:00 -> Sultan's Mother's Incense Burner (Arabian Sea Northeast Coast)
Unlocks: Special Dark Green Metal Paneling

Lower Left / 8:00 -> Scented Gloves of a Princess (Paris)
Unlocks: Fragrance Gloves

Upper Left / 10:00 -> Incense Burner of 3-Legged Frog
Unlocks: Special Dark Green Wooden Paneling

Center -> Aromatic Oil of Egypt's Queen (Luxor*)
Unlocks: Ancient Aromatic Oil Glass Bottle

The recipe details are contained on their respective item's pages/comments.

Memorial Album Reward: Queen's Perfume Bottle
Obtained from: Princess Marguerite (Nantes)
And the custom nicknames mentioned by shoelace become available on obtaining your MA reward.

Note that center Luxor discovery is impossible to obtain until you have completed City of the living which unlocks that region. The 'discovery->recipe unlocked' condition seems to apply only to mini-update Legacy additions and not main chapter Legacy updates like the future Chapter 2: Rhodes and Ephesos. Cheers.

Thanks to: Beomi (helping confirm discovery locations/noting them down), Wittyship (for their awesome blog), shoelace (nickname info)
Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Quest%2FAdventure%2FLegacy (Aroma/Perfume sub-section) , wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1250.html (recipes/pics)
